description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 3010015233201 ACTUATOR,HYDRAULIC-: Line 0001 Qty 4 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0160 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
